title: Local Models with Ollama
description: Run and integrate local LLMs with Ollama for privacy and cost efficiency.

data.text: Ollama makes it easy to run local LLMs. Integrate with .NET via HTTP API for privacy and cost efficiency.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Trade model quality for privacy and cost
data.takeaway: Local models provide privacy and cost savings but trade off quality. Use Ollama for simple integration with local LLMs.
